scenarios.prompt: Two humanoid assets use different rest poses and socket naming. Publish a canonical rig contract that lets locomotion and weapon attachment interoperate.

criteria.ownership: Standardizes skeleton/rest pose/axis/socket/contact contracts while adapters own runtime conversion.
criteria.optional_joints: Toe/ball and twist joints are capabilities with declared fallback, not universal minimum requirements.
criteria.evidence: Retarget/socket/contact tests verify both required and optional joint variants before claiming compatibility.
